root_cause.text: The `ath12k` wireless driver incorrectly passes aligned DMA buffer addresses instead of the original unaligned addresses returned by `dma_alloc_coherent()` when calling `dma_free_coherent()` to free copy engine (CE) ring buffers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff for `drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath12k/ce.c` replaces the aligned address fields `base_addr_owner_space` and `base_addr_ce_space` with `base_addr_owner_space_unaligned` and `base_addr_ce_space_unaligned` in the `dma_free_coherent()` calls within `ath12k_ce_free_pipes()`.
